carrier.type: Open-back fins with discrete grounded starter ribs and flush-cut necks

area_coverage.method: Area-weighted rear coverage and tributary-area constrained fin allocation

carrier.cleanup: Cradle face in lined caul. Cut 1.2 mm necks individually through rear pockets, flush with rear lands; remove ribs progressively, then sand rear lands on flat plate.
carrier.contact_coordinate_basis: assembly rotated 90 degrees about Z before 55 degree lean
